subject: dsa
title: Longest Palindromic Substring
summary: Every palindrome has a center. Try each index as a center, expand outward while both sides match, and keep the longest stretch found.
problem: Given a string, return its longest contiguous substring that reads the same forwards and backwards.

steps.caption: A palindrome reads the same both ways and has a center. Try every center, expand while both sides match, and keep the longest.
Start an odd-length center at index 1 ('a'), with L = R = 1.
Expand outward: index 0 ('b') and index 2 ('b') match, so the palindrome grows.
"bab" is a palindrome of length 3. Expanding again would push L off the left end, so we stop here.
Try center at index 2 ('b') and expand: index 1 ('a') matches index 3 ('a'), giving "aba", another length-3 palindrome.
Expand once more: index 0 ('b') versus index 4 ('d'). They differ, so this center stops.
The longest palindrome is "bab" of length 3. "aba" ties, but "bab" appears first.
